hook: Microsoft's Agent Framework package on PyPI was compromised with malicious versions.
hooks: Microsoft's Agent Framework package on PyPI was compromised with malicious versions.
Hackers uploaded two fake releases that stole cloud credentials from developers.
The package sees roughly 200,000 monthly downloads on PyPI.
what_happened: Two malicious versions (1.26.1 and 1.26.2) of Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package were published, stealing cloud credentials during Python startup.
why_it_matters: Developers’ cloud secrets can be exfiltrated silently, exposing Azure, AWS, GitHub and other services to attackers.
what_to_do: Reinstall the safe 1.26.0 release and rotate any exposed credentials.
the_catch: The method the attacker used to gain publishing access is unknown.
caption: Two malicious versions of Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package stole cloud credentials from developers. Did you install the compromised version?
alt_text: The carousel explains that malicious releases of Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package stole cloud credentials, advises reinstalling version 1.26.0, and notes the unknown breach method.

es.hook: El paquete Agent Framework de Microsoft en PyPI fue comprometido con versiones maliciosas.
es.what_happened: Los atacantes publicaron dos versiones maliciosas (1.26.1 y 1.26.2) del paquete Agent Framework de Microsoft en PyPI, y robaron credenciales de la nube al iniciar Python.
es.why_it_matters: Los secretos en la nube de los desarrolladores pueden exfiltrarse silenciosamente, exponiendo Azure, AWS, GitHub y otros servicios a los atacantes.
es.what_to_do: Reinstala la versión segura 1.26.0 y rota cualquier credencial expuesta.
es.the_catch: Los investigadores desconocen cómo el atacante obtuvo acceso para publicar.
